context: A family member is admitted to hospital
purpose: Handle an admission; teach 入院/失っ/ショック/制御/緩和/表面/確信/ニーズ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 父が倒れて、入院することになりました。
lines.en: My father collapsed and is being hospitalized.
lines.style: worried daughter explaining anxiously, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 一時的に意識を失っていたそうですね。
lines.en: He briefly lost consciousness, I hear.
lines.style: calm doctor confirming gently, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家族はショックを受けています。
lines.style: shaken daughter sharing her state, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ご安心を。今は血圧を制御できています。
lines.en: Rest assured. We’re controlling his blood pressure now.
lines.style: reassuring doctor steadying her, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: concerned daughter asking, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 緩和の処置をしましたから、楽なはずです。
lines.en: We applied relief measures, so he should be comfortable.
lines.style: doctor explaining the care, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 皮膚の表面に傷もありますね。
lines.en: There are wounds on the skin’s surface too.
lines.style: observant daughter noting, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 軽いものです。回復には確信を持っています。
lines.en: They’re minor. I’m confident about recovery.
lines.style: doctor offering firm reassurance, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 患者のニーズに、よく応えてくださって。
lines.en: Thank you for meeting the patient’s needs so well.
lines.style: grateful daughter thanking him, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
